shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && cat package.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)"
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides; cat migrating-to-cache-components.md | head -250; grep -rn -i "Math.random\|randomUUID\|crypto" ../03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md 2>/dev/null | head

f=.next/server/app/index.html; grep -o '<nav>[^<]*</nav>' $f; grep -o 'Loading request details[^<]*' $f; grep -c 'generated at' $f; grep -rn "instant\s*=" app components || echo "no instant opt-outs"; git status --short
